dynamic imports/config/plugin/page selectors: selected runtime routes and state mode; explicit historical reproduction is test/archive only
entrypoints/Docker/Compose/cron/systemd/Timefolio: root src-only images and selected runtime import graph; rollback manifests retained
tests: immutable historical oracle bytes, economic/Golden/negative/Timefolio suites independently executed
rollback: old source SHA/blob and byte-exact MOV05 archive map; no original data or old receipt deleted
